races.name: Hayley Middleton Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tiny Riot
runners_data.note: Recent winner with strong Skelton yard form and Durrell's big-race experience crucial in tactical affair

runners_data.name: Steel Fixer
runners_data.note: Tongue-tie first time suggests breathing issues, but Ellison yard historically strong with equipment changes

runners_data.name: Vietnorm
runners_data.note: Two-time winner with solid recent form but 13-day gap could blunt race sharpness in sprint finish

runners_data.name: Cracking Anna
runners_data.note: Consistent fading pattern in recent runs suggests stamina limitations over this extended trip

races.paceDynamic: With all four runners carrying identical Hold Up styles, this becomes a tactical crawl from the start. No natural pace-setter exists among Tiny Riot, Steel Fixer, Vietnorm, and Cracking Anna, creating a pedestrian early gallop that will inevitably produce a bunched field turning for home. The lack of early pace will compress the finish into a sprint from the final furlong, where superior acceleration and race fitness will prove decisive. This race shape strongly favours horses with proven finishing kick and sharp turn of foot over those who need strong early pace to be effective.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Sprint Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the field crawls through halfway and bunches into a cavalry charge from two out
scenarios.body: The compressed finish becomes a pure test of acceleration where recent winner Tiny Riot's superior form and Skelton stable strength can dominate. Vietnorm's dual win streak also positions him perfectly for this type of finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Breakaway Attempt
scenarios.trigger: If one runner breaks the tactical deadlock and forces genuine pace from the start
scenarios.body: Steel Fixer or Vietnorm could exploit their stamina to stretch the field, though the hold-up merchants behind will still get their chance. The imposed pace benefits those with proven staying power over pure sprinters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If genuine pace materializes and the race becomes a true staying test over the extended trip
scenarios.body: Vietnorm's consistent record at longer distances and Steel Fixer's trainer form gives them the edge in a grinding finish. The extended trip plays against those who rely purely on acceleration.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Drama
scenarios.trigger: If the tactical nature produces stop-start fractions and a messy finish with interference
scenarios.body: The jockey factor becomes crucial with Durrell's big-race experience on Tiny Riot potentially decisive in a rough finish. Form horses struggle when racing luck becomes paramount.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early tactical positioning as all four share hold-up styles creating potential traffic problems
Monitor Steel Fixer's breathing with first-time tongue-tie potentially transforming performance level
Observe Vietnorm's early race keenness given the 13-day gap potentially affecting race fitness
Watch Cracking Anna for signs of her usual late fade pattern emerging from two furlongs out
Track jockey positioning through the early crawl as race-riding experience becomes crucial in tactical finish

races.name: Rase Vets Summer Party Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Swingingonthesteel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 116 days off but showed winning form before the break and handles good ground well

runners_data.name: Brionywells
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent recent form with two wins but has shown tendency to fade in the finish which is concerning

runners_data.name: Jessie Jump Jet
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up performer who has been running well in similar company and should appreciate the likely strong pace

runners_data.name: Slack Alice
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs pace to aim at and the good going suits based on previous form patterns

runners_data.name: Newmill Getaway
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has been consistent lately and the 7-year-old experience could prove valuable in tactical battle

runners_data.name: Popa Rich
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying just 147lbs which could be significant advantage if getting into contention late

runners_data.name: Ramaah
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who needs everything to fall right but the light weight of 145lbs gives her a chance

runners_data.name: Mc'flo
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with poor recent form and no obvious angle to recommend him in this field

races.paceDynamic: Swingingonthesteel and Newmill Getaway will contest the early lead, with both horses having prominent tendencies and the tactical speed to dictate terms. The sustainable pace they set will allow the large contingent of hold-up horses (Brionywells, Jessie Jump Jet, Slack Alice, Popa Rich, Ramaah, Mc'flo) to get into contention turning for home. With six runners needing to come from off the pace against just two pace-setters, this creates a tactical disadvantage for the leaders who may get swamped late. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, particularly those with proven finishing kicks like Brionywells and Jessie Jump Jet.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady allowing closers to build momentum
scenarios.body: The large pack of hold-up horses will have every chance to unleash their finishing kicks, with Brionywells and Jessie Jump Jet best positioned to capitalize. The leaders Swingingonthesteel and Newmill Getaway will find themselves outnumbered and vulnerable to the late charge.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Two Control
scenarios.trigger: If Swingingonthesteel and Newmill Getaway establish an unassailable advantage
scenarios.body: These two prominent runners can dictate fractions that suit their styles and kick clear before the closers can respond. Swingingonthesteel's recent winning form gives him the edge over Newmill Getaway in a straight fight.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Pace
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast trying to break the field
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for the proven finishers, with Brionywells having the class advantage despite her finishing concerns. Slack Alice and Jessie Jump Jet can take advantage of the pace collapse to get competitive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the lower-rated hold-up horses benefit from a perfect pace setup
scenarios.body: Popa Rich or Ramaah could spring a surprise if the race unfolds to suit their closing styles perfectly. The light weights they carry could prove decisive in a slowly-run affair that becomes a sprint finish.

watchPoints.text: Swingingonthesteel's fitness after 116 days layoff could be exposed if forced to battle early with Newmill Getaway
Brionywells' tendency to fade in the finish could cost her if she hits the front too early despite her class advantage
The pace battle between Swingingonthesteel and Newmill Getaway will determine whether the hold-up horses get their perfect setup
Popa Rich's recent poor runs including a fall make her hard to trust despite the weight advantage
Jessie Jump Jet's consistency makes him the safest option among the hold-up horses if the pace collapses

races.name: Rebecca Brooks Handicap Chase

runners_data.name: Ask A Sainte
runners_data.note: Natural front runner with recent winning form who should handle the Good going and gets Sean Bowen's experience from the front

runners_data.name: Tsavo Park
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer carrying a 5lb claimer against classier opponents, needs pace collapse to be competitive from the rear

runners_data.name: Get A Superstar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent recent form with a decisive win last time, well-suited to sitting close to the pace

runners_data.name: Prospect House
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent performer with strong course record, carries only 3lb penalty and gets valuable claiming allowance

runners_data.name: Blue Bear
runners_data.note: Lightweight hold-up horse from lower grade who needs everything to fall right from the back of this small field

runners_data.name: Fast Deal
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with documented finishing problems who faces a significant class rise against better opposition

races.paceDynamic: Ask A Sainte will take the lead from the start with Get A Superstar and Prospect House pressing just behind in the early stages. The pace will be steady but sustainable given the lack of genuine speed horses in this small field. Tsavo Park, Blue Bear and Fast Deal will sit further back looking to make late moves. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and kick when the tempo lifts, as the hold-up horses lack the class to make up significant ground from the back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Ask A Sainte sets a steady tempo without serious pressure through the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of staying power from the three-furlong pole where the prominent runners can respond quickest. Hold-up horses find themselves with too much to do against classier opponents.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ask A Sainte goes too slow and the field bunches up turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where positioning matters more than class, allowing the back markers to close the gap. Fast Deal's known finishing weakness becomes less relevant in a slowly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Get A Superstar or Prospect House press Ask A Sainte from an early stage creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The strong tempo finds out the stamina of all runners with only the most genuine stayers lasting home. This exposes Fast Deal's finishing frailties and tests Blue Bear's lower grade credentials.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a messy crawl until the final half-mile
scenarios.body: Tsavo Park or Blue Bear could capitalize on superior finishing kick against tired prominent runners. This requires perfect timing from claiming jockeys which seems unlikely given the opposition quality.

watchPoints.text: Fast Deal's tendency to fade in the finish could see him pulled up if the pace is strong early
Paddy Hanlon's 5lb claim on Tsavo Park might not be enough to overcome the class deficit in this company
Ask A Sainte's jumping under pressure will be crucial if Get A Superstar or Prospect House challenge early
Blue Bear needs the leaders to come back to him significantly given the 26lb weight differential with the top-rated horses
Prospect House's trainer Peter Niven has had no runners in the past 14 days which could indicate freshness concerns

races.name: Bob And Babs Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Hurricane Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with recent winning form but needs the pace to collapse to be effective from his patient style

runners_data.name: King Roly
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who should get an uncontested lead but needs to prove his stamina over this extended trip

runners_data.name: Fringill Dike
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer whose recent form shows consistency but requires strong pace to unleash his finishing kick

runners_data.name: Maximum Offers
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form with a trainer hitting 33% strike rate over past 14 days

runners_data.name: Doyouknowwhatimean
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits the likely pace scenario but inconsistent recent form raises reliability questions

runners_data.name: Okavango Delta
runners_data.note: Prominent runner carrying just 154lbs but trainer struggling with form and long absence since last win

runners_data.name: Wudya
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who could benefit from the weight allowance but trainer's poor recent record is concerning

races.paceDynamic: King Roly will lead from the outset with his prominent style and front-running tendencies, likely setting a comfortable gallop over this intermediate trip. With most of the field rated as prominent runners rather than pure hold-up horses, there should be reasonable company for King Roly through the early stages without excessive pressure. The lack of confirmed strong stayers and the good ground conditions will create a race where those able to track the pace and kick from prominent positions hold the tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to King Roly and strike turning for home.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If King Roly sets a reasonable gallop and the prominent runners get perfect tracking positions
scenarios.body: The pace will be honest but not destructive, allowing the higher-rated prominent runners to time their challenges perfectly turning for home. Maximum Offers and King Roly can utilise their class advantage from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop becomes too fast or King Roly gets pressured by multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The pace will collapse in the final furlong, setting up a late charge from Hurricane Bay or Fringill Dike who can finish strongest. Hurricane Bay's recent winning form gives him the edge in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: King Roly Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If King Roly gets an uncontested lead and his stamina proves superior over this trip
scenarios.body: Sean Bowen can dictate terms from the front and kick clear before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge. His course experience and prominent style perfectly suit these tactics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners pressure King Roly early and create a stop-start gallop
scenarios.body: The race will become a tactical affair with multiple horses still in contention at the last fence, favouring those with the best finishing kicks. Wudya or Okavango Delta could capitalise on the confusion with their lower weights.

Hurricane Bay jumping fluently in the early stages as his hold-up style needs smooth travel to be effective

races.name: Rase Veterinary Summer Party Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Pigeon House
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest rating but 27 days off and must overcome front-running bias from poor position.

runners_data.name: Trust House
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent form for in-form Olly Murphy, perfectly placed to exploit tactical advantage.

runners_data.name: Kingston Sunflower
runners_data.note: Veteran front-runner with solid recent form, though 5lb claimer adds slight experience concern in tactical battle.

runners_data.name: Ip Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse on lowest rating carrying lightest weight but faces same positional disadvantage as Pigeon House.

races.paceDynamic: Trust House and Kingston Sunflower will set a moderate gallop from the front with no other confirmed pace-pressers in this small field. The early pace should be comfortable, allowing both prominent runners to travel well through the first circuit. With Pigeon House and Ip Up both hold-up horses, the race will develop into a waiting game before quickening significantly from three out. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours the front-runners who can dictate terms and kick clear when the hold-up horses are still working their way into contention.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Trust House and Kingston Sunflower get an easy lead and comfortable sectionals
scenarios.body: The pace-setters will have plenty left in the tank to resist the late challenge, with the hold-up horses unable to make up the ground in time. This plays perfectly into the hands of horses who can dictate from the front without early pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the race becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will benefit from a truly-run finish where their closing speed can be maximized. Pigeon House's class advantage becomes telling in a finish where tactical speed matters most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Trust House or Kingston Sunflower falter in the closing stages after setting the pace
scenarios.body: The surviving front-runner will pick up the pieces as the hold-up horses still have too much ground to make up. One pace-setter benefits from the other's demise while maintaining positional advantage.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If jockey tactics backfire with all horses waiting too long to make their move
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where positioning and luck at the business end determines the outcome. The horse who finds the clearest passage and quickest response will prevail regardless of early tactics.

watchPoints.text: Trust House and Kingston Sunflower getting an uncontested lead through the first mile will make them very difficult to peg back
Pigeon House needs to be closer than usual turning for home given the small field and likely lack of pace
Sean Bowen's tactics on Trust House in the early stages as he has the form edge over Kingston Sunflower
How much the 5lb claim helps Kingston Sunflower's jumping rhythm under Fern O'Brien
Any early mistakes from the hold-up horses will effectively end their chances in this tactical affair

races.name: Rase Equine Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Little Ledgend
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose style suits this tactical setup but 115 days off the track raises fitness concerns despite solid recent form figures

runners_data.name: Roxboro River
runners_data.note: Hold-up style may struggle in compact field but highest similar-going record (14/15 runs) and trainer in good form provide confidence

runners_data.name: Estacas
runners_data.note: Patient type with proven good ground form but needs luck in running from his hold-up style against this pace scenario

runners_data.name: Born Like Me
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose 5-year-old scope appeals but poor trainer strike-rate (1/11) and lack of placed efforts on similar going concern

runners_data.name: Bunker Bay
runners_data.note: Recent winner whose 7lb weight pull and promising headgear changes offset hold-up style disadvantage in this pace setup

runners_data.name: Knacker Trapper
runners_data.note: Prominent style perfectly suits race shape but poor trainer record (0/1 recent) and 8-year-old's inconsistency remain question marks

runners_data.name: Zuul
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with significant weight advantage (12lbs) but style conflicts with likely pace scenario and trainer form patchy

races.paceDynamic: Little Ledgend and Knacker Trapper will set a measured early gallop with their prominent styles, but neither is a confirmed tearaway leader so the pace should be sustainable rather than frantic. With five hold-up horses in the field, there will be a large pack tracking the leaders through the early stages, creating potential for traffic problems at hurdles. The relatively gentle early pace will suit the patient types, but when the tempo lifts from three out, those handy to the pace will have the tactical advantage. This race shape strongly favours horses that can sit prominent or travel well in midfield, as pure hold-up horses may struggle to make ground from the back of this compact field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Types Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Little Ledgend and Knacker Trapper maintain forward positions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The measured gallop allows them to conserve energy while avoiding the scramble behind, giving them first run when the pace quickens approaching the business end. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic or find the steady tempo doesn't suit their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and the leaders weaken significantly
scenarios.body: A patient type like Estacas or Roxboro River can use their superior class ratings to sweep past tired front-runners in the final half-mile. The pace collapse creates the perfect setup for their closing style to be effective.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Bunker Bay Gets Up
scenarios.trigger: If the in-form winner can get a smooth passage and the pace sets up right
scenarios.body: His recent Sedgefield success and 7lb weight advantage could prove decisive if he avoids the traffic problems that often plague hold-up horses. The conditional jockey's 3lb claim becomes crucial in a tight finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If both prominent runners go too fast early and fade badly
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the back where pure finishing speed matters most, potentially suiting the inconsistent but capable Zuul with his 12lb weight advantage. Multiple hold-up horses get competitive simultaneously creating chaos.

Knacker Trapper's early positioning - needs to be handy but not lead given inconsistent finishing efforts
